beats.text: I lost $18,000 on one missing contract.
beats.label: HOOK

beats.text: The client said yes on a call and I never sent the paperwork.
Two months later they said the scope was different.
I had nothing in writing, so I ate the cost.
beats.label: MID

beats.text: Now every yes gets a one-page contract inside 24 hours.
Comment CONTRACT and I'll send you mine, the one that would have saved me $18,000.
beats.label: CTA

notes: Beat(s) 2, 6 run past 4s. Either split the line or change what is on screen inside it. A static frame is where people leave.
Beats 2-4 have nothing concrete in them. Put a number, a name or a price in one of them.
Loops: the last beat repeats "$18,000, contract" from the hook. Second watches are free reach.
